claims: XRP Insights' latest accessible pinned observation is ledger 108037957 at 2026-11-01 04:35 UTC; its tracker reports the two November 1 EscrowFinish events totaling 1B XRP, zero re-escrow by that ledger, and 1B XRP net outside escrow at the cutoff.
The same tracker reports a rolling 12-cycle re-escrow ratio of 64.2%, with 7.7B of 12B XRP re-escrowed; this is a rolling observation, not a protocol rule.
Binance Recovery Update #4 reports approximately 95% aggregate incident replenishment and includes XRP among ten assets it says are 100% backed.

Binance's 06:00–09:00 UTC November 1 phase-one withdrawal window includes the XRP network and is progressive. At the 06:05 UTC capture, the window was in progress but actual XRP availability was not confirmed.

The Binance network-status page displayed a last-updated time of 05:28:24 AM (timezone not specified) and a server-rendered 'No records' table; this does not establish that XRP withdrawals were open or suspended.
Reuters reports the same Binance Update #4 announcement and is not independent reserve verification.
Main advanced to 694fc4241f543917fc6eb787c025bf1eb6726595 at 06:03:40 UTC via a telemetry-report commit that changed only the report timestamp while retaining a Status: OPERATIONAL claim.
PR #1443 passed exact-head CI with 349 tests and 8 subtests and its fail-closed gate passed, but it remains open, draft and unmerged.

PR #1444 consolidates the PR #1443 changes with seven additional workflow safeguards. Its previous exact-head CI failed four assertions; the causes were identified and corrected in head 680037388ba80f0ed75eccb918469123dfd69bea. Exact-head rerun has not yet been observed.

previous_head_failure_causes: two test assertions used case-sensitive matching for the disabled HF admin message
